City of South Lake Tahoe
                               Planning Commission
                              Meeting Agenda
                    Thursday, August 20, 2026 at 3:00 pm
   City Hall - Council Chambers - 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe



Planning Commission
Julia Lucksinger, Chair
Gavin Feiger, Vice Chair
Steven Imhoff, Commissioner
Douglas Williams, Commissioner
Erika Gonzalez, Commissioner



Public Participation
Planning Commission meetings are held in person at the time and location listed on this agenda. A
public agenda packet is available for review at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, on the City's website at
https://www.cityofslt.gov/, or by contacting the City Clerk's Office, (530) 542-6005 or
sblankenship@cityofslt.gov.
Providing Public Comment:
Remote Public Participation: If you would like to participate remotely, please join the ZOOM meeting
by using this link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87165332454. If you would like to make a comment, wait for
the agenda item to begin, then press the "raise hand" button. Meetings are also live-streamed on
Channel 21, the City's website at https://www.cityofslt.gov/, and YouTube at
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3LYne8Ih-kTPLnnuyJW9SQ/live.
In Person: Every agenda for regular meetings provides an opportunity for members of the public to
directly address the legislative body (Planning Commission), on any item of public interest which is within
the jurisdiction of the Planning Commission during Public Communications. For items on the agenda or
in connection with any item which the Planning Commission will consider, the public is given the
opportunity to comment before or during the Planning Commission's consideration of the item
[Government Code Section 54954.3(a)].
In Writing: Written comments received by 3 p.m. the day before the meeting will be distributed to the
Planning Commission prior to the meeting. Written public comment regarding any item on this agenda
may be sent to PublicComment@cityofslt.gov. When emailing comments, identify the agenda item
number in the subject line to which your comments relate. Any such comment that is a public record and
is emailed to PublicComment@cityofslt.gov or otherwise provided to a majority of the Planning
Commission before the meeting will be made available for public inspection during normal business
hours at the City Clerk's Office located at City Hall, 1901 Lisa Maloff Way, South Lake Tahoe
[Government Code Section 54957.5(b)]. Written comments will not be read out loud during the meeting.
Spanish Interpretations: The public may access Spanish interpretation using the ZOOM link listed on
the front of the Agenda from an internet device (smartphone, laptop, tablet, home computer) with audio
capabilities and selecting the Spanish language option. Persons without an internet device may attend

the meeting in -person and a device will be provided while supplies last. Requests for interpreter services
to offer public comment may be made by contacting the City Clerk.
The City Council Chambers meeting facility is accessible to people with disabilities. Every reasonable
effort will be made to accommodate any person needing special assistance to attend this meeting.
Contact the City Clerk at (530) 542-6005 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting for assistance [28
CFR 35.102.35.104 ADA Title II and Brown Act Government Code Sections 54953.2, 54954.1, 54954.2,
and 54957.5].

Call to Order/Pledge of Allegiance

Roll Call

Public Communications
This is the public's opportunity to speak on any topic NOT LISTED on this agenda. Comments shall be
limited to three (3) minutes. In accordance with the Brown Act, the Planning Commission cannot
deliberate or vote on any matter raised under public communications but may briefly respond to
statements made or questions posed (Government Code Sections 54954.2).

Consent
Public Comment - This is the public's opportunity to speak on any topic listed on the Consent Agenda.
Comments shall be limited to three (3) minutes.

The consent agenda consists of items of a repeating or routine nature considered under a single action.
Any Commissioner may have an item on the consent agenda removed and considered separately upon
request.

Pass a Motion to adopt the Consent Agenda in one motion except as indicated at each item.

1.   Planning Commission Meeting Minutes
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Motion to approve the June 11, 2026 Planning
     Commission meeting minutes.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Yvette Miranda, Administrative Clerk II
     Item 1- Executive Summary.pdf
     06 11 2026 PC Minutes.pdf

New Business

2.   Recommended Adoption of the Mid-Town Area/Specific Plan and Initial Study/Negative Declaration
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a motion to adopt a resolution recommending that the
     City Council adopt the Mid-Town Area/Specific Plan and the Initial Study/Negative Declaration.
     CEQA Determination: Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, Cal. Pub. Res. Code
     section 21000 et seq., potential environmental impacts of the proposed MTAP have been evaluated
     in an Initial Study (IS). The IS determined that there are no impacts, or all impacts are less than
     significant, and a Negative Declaration was prepared.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Anna Kashuba, Senior Planner
     Item 2- Executive Summary.pdf

     02_MTAP_PC-Rec_Reso.docx
     03_Mid-TownAreaPlan.pdf
     04_MTAP_IS_IEC_ND_20260721.pdf
     05_Outreach Summary and Appendices.pdf
     06_Mid-Town Map.pdf
     07_TribuneNotice.pdf
     08_TribuneNotice (2).pdf

3.   Eleven-Unit Residential Project Major Design Review & Special Use Permit Revision, 1050
     Fremont Avenue, APNs 027-170-012 and 027-381-001
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Pass a Motion to adopt a Resolution 1) Finding the revised
     project remains categorically exempt from CEQA pursuant to Section 15332, Class 32, Infill
     Developments; 2) Approving the plan revision to the Major Design Review and Special Use Permit
     under project file #REV26-002; and 3) Making all other findings set forth in the Resolution.
     CEQA Determination: The project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Section 15332, Class
     32, which consists of projects characterized as infill developments. When the Eleven-Unit
     Residential Project Major Design Review & Special Use Permit was originally approved during the
     August 21, 2025 Planning Commission meeting under Resolution 2025-008, a notice of exemption
     was filed pursuant to CEQA guidelines. The proposed plan revision does not constitute a new
     CEQA determination.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Gretchen Schooleman, Assistant City Planner

4.   General Plan 2027 - 2035 Housing Element Update
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Receive report and provide comments on the draft 2027-
     2035 Housing Element.
     CEQA Determination: The proposed Housing Element is consistent with the 2030 General Plan and
     directly implements several of the General Plan policies and the proposed ordinance is consistent
     with and implements the 2022 â€“ 2027 Housing Element, which is an integral part of the General
     Plan. The 2030 General Plan EIR adequately addresses the potential environmental impacts of the
     proposed Housing Element. The General Plan EIR is available on the City website at:
     https://www.cityofslt.gov/DocumentCenter/View/15121/General-Plan-Environmental-Impact-Report?
     bidId=
     Responsible Staff Member(s): Jessica Wackenhut Lomeli, Housing Manager

5.   Planning Commission Approved Projects Status Report
     Requested Action / Suggested Motions: Presentation only; no action is required.
     Responsible Staff Member(s): John Hitchcock, Planning Manager

Planning Commissioner Reports and Comments

Adjournment

I, Michelle Davis, Assistant City Clerk for the for the City of South Lake Tahoe, declare that the foregoing

agenda for the Thursday, August 20, 2026, meeting of the City of South Lake Tahoe Planning
Commission was posted and available for review on August 13, 2026, at City Hall - 1901 Lisa Maloff
Way, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150. The agenda was also available on the city website at
https://www.cityofslt.gov/.

Signed 8/13/2026
Michelle Davis, Assistant City Clerk

Note: The decision of the Planning Commission to approve a design review permit or grant a use permit
or a variance may be appealed to the City Council. This appeal shall be filed with the City Clerk within
fifteen (15) days from the date of the decision and requires a payment of applicable fees.
